cc:Work.dc:title: 01 | Search the whole clock, then ask whether any region is stable
cc:Work.dc:description: 3 × 96 quarter-hour anchors × 4 durations × 3 directions = 3,456 searched cells · 3,338 valid · 118 invalid. Only DE30 formed supported price-only regions; none survived a hypothetical +0.05R/trade regional stress. Entire surface is discovery.
